reviewChapter.name: Chapter Review
reviewChapter.desc: Comprehensive quality review of a specified chapter, covering plot logic, character consistency, pacing, foreshadowing, and more.
reviewChapter.when: When the user asks to review, check, or evaluate a chapter

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.desc: Creative brainstorming on a given topic, generating multiple creative directions and inspiration.
brainstorm.when: When the user asks for brainstorming, inspiration, or creative ideas

characterAnalysis.name: Character Analysis
characterAnalysis.desc: In-depth analysis of a specified character's personality, motivations, character arc, relationships, and more.
characterAnalysis.when: When the user wants to understand or adjust a character's settings

continuityCheck.name: Continuity Check
continuityCheck.desc: Check for setting consistency and continuity issues in the novel, discovering contradictions and omissions.
continuityCheck.when: When the user wants to check for setting contradictions or inconsistencies

writingCoach.name: Writing Coach
writingCoach.desc: Professional writing technique guidance and prose improvement suggestions.
writingCoach.when: When the user wants to improve writing skills or learn writing techniques

tools.pathOutOfBounds: Path out of bounds: "{{path}}" is outside the project directory. Only project files are accessible.

listChapters.desc: List all chapter status overview in the project, including which chapters have blueprints, drafts, finalized versions, etc. For understanding overall project progress.
listChapters.noData: 📊 No chapter data in the project yet. Consider generating story architecture and chapter blueprints first.

openEditor.desc: Open a specified file's tab in the Vela editor. Users can view and edit content directly in the editor.
openEditor.filePathDesc: File path relative to project root

readArchitecture.desc: Read the novel's story architecture files (four-part architecture: premise, worldbuilding, character map, plot outline, etc.). Core tool for understanding the novel's overall structure.
readArchitecture.fileNameDesc: Architecture file name (optional). If empty, lists all architecture files. E.g. "premise.md", "worldbuilding.md"
readArchitecture.empty: ⚠️ Architecture is empty, no architecture files yet. Consider generating story architecture via workflow.

readBlueprint.desc: Read the blueprint for a specified chapter (plot outline, scene allocation, character appearance plan, etc.). Blueprints are detailed plans before writing.
readBlueprint.chapterNumberDesc: Chapter number (optional). If empty, lists all blueprint files.
readBlueprint.notFound: Chapter {{chapter}} blueprint not found or failed to read
readBlueprint.title: 📋 Chapter {{chapter}} Blueprint
readBlueprint.empty: ⚠️ Blueprint is empty. Consider generating chapter blueprints via workflow first.
readBlueprint.listHint: Use the chapter_number parameter to read specific chapter blueprint content.

readCharacters.desc: Read the novel's character card files. Can get all character list or detailed information for a specified character (background, personality, appearance, character arc, etc.).
readCharacters.characterNameDesc: Character name (optional). If empty, lists all characters.
readCharacters.empty: ⚠️ Character pool is empty, no character cards yet. Consider creating character cards first.
readCharacters.listHint: Use the character_name parameter to read detailed information for a specific character.

readDrafts.desc: Read draft content for a specified chapter. Can get different versions like initial draft, revised draft, etc.
readDrafts.notFound: No draft of type "{{type}}" found. Available versions: {{available}}
readDrafts.readContentFailed: Failed to read draft content: id {{id}}
readDrafts.title: 📝 Chapter {{chapter}} Draft ({{version}})

readFile.desc: Read the content of a specified file within the project. Supports reading architecture files, blueprints, character cards, drafts, configs, and any other text files.
readFile.filePathDesc: File path relative to project root, e.g. "02_architecture/worldbuilding.md"

readProjectState.desc: Read the project's global state information, including novel config, recent chapter summaries, etc. For understanding the overall project overview.
readProjectState.noSummary: No chapter summaries yet. Summaries are auto-generated and written to blueprints after finalization.

searchKnowledge.desc: Semantic search in the knowledge base to find related reference materials, setting documents, etc. Suitable for finding world settings, character backgrounds, story materials, etc.
searchKnowledge.queryDesc: Search query, e.g. "protagonist's golden finger setting"
searchKnowledge.noResults: No related results found. Try different keywords, or use read_architecture, read_characters, and other tools to read project data directly.

startWorkflow.desc: Trigger a Vela creative workflow. Supports writing, revision, review, finalization, blueprint generation, and architecture generation workflows. This executes the corresponding multi-step creative process in the AI output panel.
startWorkflow.switched: 🚀 Switched to AI Output panel. Please start the "{{name}}{{chapterInfo}}" workflow in the panel.

updateConfig.desc: Update the novel project's configuration information, such as genre, target audience, outline, writing style, etc. This modifies core project settings and requires user confirmation.

writeFile.desc: Write or modify files within the project. Can be used to create new files or overwrite existing file content. This is a write operation that requires user confirmation.
writeFile.filePathDesc: File path relative to project root

engine.maxRounds: ⚠️ Maximum tool call limit reached, auto-stopped.
engine.resultTruncated: … (Content truncated, full content is {{count}} characters. Use the read_file tool to get the complete file content)
